FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Divisional Standing
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Drill with any colonist. Both stop, stand apart, and run through combat or containment procedure. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Review research or field notes with another Institute colonist. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Inspect a lower-ranked colonist's equipment and lab discipline. Good standards earn a commendation, lapses earn a reprimand.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Assign a lower-ranked colonist a stretch of remedial duty for a lapse, souring their mood. Once per day per colonist.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Alert every combat-ranked member of {0} on this map with a burst of speed and focus. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Order {0} to convene behind you, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They hold until dismissed.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Adjourn {0} from formation, letting them return to their duties.
